mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.workspace_id, d.knowledge_base_id, d.display_name, d.media_type, d.created_at AS document_created_at, d.updated_at AS document_updated_at, v.id AS version_id, v.version_number, v.content_sha256, v.created_at AS version_created_at, j.id AS job_id, j.status AS job_status, j.stage AS job_stage, j.attempt_count, j.max_attempts, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.available_at, j.created_at AS job_created_at, j.updated_at AS job_updated_at FROM documents d JOIN document_versions v ON v.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND v.id = d.current_version_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT job.* FROM document_versions job_version JOIN ingestion_jobs job ON job.workspace_id = job_version.workspace_id AND job.document_version_id = job_version.id WHERE job_version.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND job_version.document_id = d.id ORDER BY job_version.version_number DESC LIMIT 1 ) j ON TRUE WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
